scientific_integrity: The complete combinatorial index calculation is supported by explicit formulas, eighty enumerated tetrads and an exact maximal-minor certificate; no independence or external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Formal integer incidence lattice on sixteen nodes only, characteristic not two; not the Neron-Severi, Picard, Chow or Frobenius invariant of a specific arithmetic surface. Historical priority remains a qualified risk.
title: The integral Rosenhain-tetrad lattice and its eightfold node obstruction
